V. 12.
Thoſe whom thou haſt given me, I have guarded, and none of them is loſt, but the ſon of perdition—So one even of them whom GOD had given him is loſt. So far was even that Decree from being unchangeable! That the ſcripture might be fulfilled—That is whereby the Scripture was fulfilled. The Son of perdition ſignifies, ••e that deſervedly periſhes: as a Son of death (2 Sam. xii. 5.) Children of hell (Mat. xxiii. 15.) and children of wrath (Eph. ii. 3.) ſignify Perſons juſtly obnoxious to Death, Hell, Wrath.
